extracted_concepts.name: Product Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivative of a product: d/dx[f(x)g(x)] = f'(x)g(x) + f(x)g'(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Quotient Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivative of a quotient: d/dx[f(x)/g(x)] = [f'(x)g(x) - f(x)g'(x)]/[g(x)]^2.

extracted_concepts.name: Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The operation d/dx measuring rate of change of a function.

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiable Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function whose derivative exists.

extracted_concepts.name: Leibniz Notation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivative notation using d/dx, as in d/dx(uv).

extracted_concepts.name: Product of Functions
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function formed by multiplying functions, such as f(x)g(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Quotient of Functions
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function formed by dividing one function by another, such as f(x)/g(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Extended Product Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Product rule extended to three or more functions, e.g. d/dx(uvw) = u'vw + uv'w + uvw'.

extracted_concepts.name: Second Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The derivative of the derivative, written f''(x) or d^2f/dx^2.

extracted_concepts.name: Higher-Order Derivatives
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivatives beyond the first, such as f'''(x) and f^{(4)}(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Third Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The derivative of the second derivative, written f'''(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Fourth Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The derivative of the third derivative, written f^{(4)}(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Position Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function s(t) describing position as a function of time.

extracted_concepts.name: Velocity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The first derivative of position: s'(t) = v(t).

extracted_concepts.name: Acceleration
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The second derivative of position: s''(t) = a(t).

extracted_concepts.name: Jerk
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The third derivative of position: s'''(t).

extracted_concepts.name: Prime Notation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivative notation using primes, such as f'(x), f''(x), f'''(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Nonzero Denominator Condition
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The condition g(x) ≠ 0 required for the quotient rule.

extracted_concepts.name: Exponential Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The function e^x used in product and quotient rule examples.

extracted_concepts.name: Sine Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The trigonometric function sin x used in a quotient rule example.

extracted_concepts.name: Cosine Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The trigonometric function cos x appearing when differentiating sin x.

extracted_concepts.name: Polynomial Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Polynomial expressions such as x^2 or 1 + x^2 used in examples.
